description: Permanently delete a screenshot, logo or other media item from a software listing. Use get_my_software_details to get the media ids of uploaded files. Uploaded files (screenshots and logos) are also deleted from storage; video URL entries are only removed from the listing. Requires CRELA_API_KEY.

media_id.description: The id of the media item (from get_my_software_details response)

name: delete_media
title: Delete a Crela media item
